title: lj78 13bt Failed swap, need advice
ai_summary: A 1990 LJ78 owner paid a shop (Land Cruisers Direct) over $17,000 across 16+ months to swap a BJ74's 13B-T and A440F automatic in place of the original 2L-TE. The result was a chronic rough idle (800-1000 rpm), warped harmonic-balancer/drive pulleys, a SPAL cooling fan that kept blowing fuses, and a failing mechanical voltage regulator; after about 4,000 miles the engine lost compression in the forward cylinder. The owner describes the installation quality as poor, with loose/taped-off original wiring bundles and vacuum lines resting on hot surfaces.

complications.detail: SPAL electric fan repeatedly blew fuses/shorted relays; cracked heat-sender housing
Mechanical voltage regulator failed to charge reliably; loose, taped-off original LJ78 harness sections and vacuum lines resting on hot surfaces
Warped harmonic balancer and main drive pulley
Persistent rough idle never resolved; engine lost compression in forward cylinder after ~4,000 miles despite claimed compression testing by the shop
